# Unbounded Input Risk

The function accepts parameters to register a repository without validation of their lengths or formats. This could lead to SQL injection vulnerabilities or breaches of database constraints if invalid data is submitted.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/bootstrap.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap.register_repository`

- [knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap](../component/knowledge-compiler-compiler-bootstrap.md)
